items.example: Making the right decision can change your entire future.
Her indecision cost her the opportunity of a lifetime.
You need to make up your mind about which university to attend.
I spent days weighing up my options before accepting the job offer.
She faced a dilemma between pursuing her career and starting a family.
We have a difficult choice to make about moving abroad.
After the new information came to light, I had to reconsider my position.
A good leader needs to be decisive in times of crisis.
I hope he hasn't had a change of heart about moving.
I write a list of pros and cons before I reach my decision.
They've had second thoughts about their decision.
I can eventually come to a decision if I sleep on it.
I avoid making decisions on impulse.
I assess all possible outcomes before making a decision.
Think it over, sleep on it — don't decide in a split second.
I thought better of lending him money.
I'm torn between staying or leaving.
Do you decide what pizza you want in a split second?
Are you undecided for ages before big decisions?
If I'm sure, I'll decide quickly, without hesitation.
